Component amount currencies follow the price currency automatically (fixed amounts, tiers, and percentages with a min or max); others stay empty. This phase schedules only BLENDED and transaction-amount tiers, and rejects RETROACTIVE.

commercial.schedule.note.agreement: Scheduling checks that the price agreement is signed (legacy versions are exempt), the agreement is active and covers the start, profiles are enabled, the OE is covered by the agreement, every price matches an enabled item (relevance), every currency and condition combination of each enablement has a price (completeness), tiers are contiguous, and periods within a plan don't overlap.
commercial.schedule.note.template: Standard price templates get structural checks only (contiguous tiers, non-overlapping periods within a plan), and each template plan has a single active version; they aren't used for runtime pricing.

commercial.template.workspace.note: Standard price templates cover every payment method and feature the platform sells and aren't limited by agreement enablements; when a new agreement version is generated "From Standard Price Template", only the parts enabled on the agreement are taken. After a template publishes a new version, agreements referencing the old version show "Standard price updated", and agreement prices don't change.
commercial.templatePicker.failed: Couldn't load standard price templates. Please try again later.
commercial.templatePicker.none: No standard price template is available for this OE and term type
commercial.templates.createFailed: Couldn't create the standard price template
commercial.templates.createNote: One OE can have several named templates (such as Standard and Discount). After creating one, create its first version, edit prices and submit it for review.
commercial.templates.note: A standard price template is a platform-owned price plan (per OE, several allowed). It reuses the version, price and review flow, with review permissions separate from agreement prices. It isn't used for runtime pricing; it only serves as the source for new agreement versions and the baseline for below-standard comparisons.
commercial.terms.compareSamePlan: Only two versions of the same plan can be compared.
commercial.terms.note: Status flow: Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Client Signed (legacy versions exempt) → Scheduled → Active → Superseded / Expired. On the Versions tab, select two versions of the same plan to compare prices. Standard price templates are maintained on the "Standard Price Templates" page.

commercial.version.matrix.eventCount: {count, plural, one {# billing event} other {# billing events}}
commercial.version.matrix.note: Prices are grouped by enablement and sorted by OE, currency and priority within each group. "Below Standard" means lower than the source standard price template (hover to see template values); "No Standard to Compare" means the component has no source or the template has no matching item. Grouping is a page approximation; commercial's relevance check is final.

commercial.versionTransition.submit.body: Once submitted, prices are frozen and the version is pending approval; you're recorded as the Maker, and the approver can't be you.
